declared.title: Let it be: Accepting negative emotional experiences predicts decreased negative affect and depressive symptoms
declared.foundIn: docs/design/review-science.md (dossier du pilote, 2026-11-22) ; titre de mémoire de la session

findings.text: Women who accept their negative emotions feel less negative affect during a sad induction

support.sentence: Results indicated that acceptance was correlated with decreased negative affect during a negative emotion induction but not an affectively neutral condition (Study 1).

findings.text: Acceptance predicts fewer depressive symptoms after high life stress, not after low stress

support.sentence: In Study 2, acceptance interacted with life stress such that acceptance predicted lower levels of depressive symptoms after higher, but not lower, life stress.
